topic.title: Quiz Game
topic.description: A True/False quiz game built with OOP across four files: Question model, QuizBrain controller, question data, and main entry point. Demonstrates real multi-file Python project structure.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Organising code across multiple files, using classes to manage application state, and having objects reference each other (QuizBrain holds a list of Question objects).
learningNotes.challenges: Keeping import paths correct across files and ensuring QuizBrain properly iterates and scores the questions.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add more categories, a timer per question, and a graphical interface with tkinter.

files.description: Entry point: creates Question list and QuizBrain, runs quiz.
QuizBrain class managing question flow and score tracking.
